recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-3824 unless a new work-group issue asks to redesign current navigation labels beyond this historical DSTU1 request.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core request to rename unclear tab labels: make the old Packages label clearer and replace Formal Definitions with Detailed Descriptions because those pages contained more than formal definitions.
initial_application: Jira records SVN revision 3602. Git-svn commit d8c1759c3428878e3bbfda9b178d948d99053f96, titled "{#3824}: change tab names", applied the Formal Definitions to Detailed Descriptions rename across datatype/resource definition pages and templates. The Jira comment saying Packages became profiles is explained by the related FHIR-5585/SVN 4492 profile terminology change.
additional_context: Current source has been substantially refactored since DSTU1, but build-scoped datatype/resource definition pages still use Detailed Descriptions, resource profile pages use Profiles, and the remaining packages.html page is explicitly about FHIR NPM Packages rather than the old conformance-package tab. Remaining Formal Definitions strings are column labels for XML/JSON formal artifacts, not the misleading tab/page label targeted by the issue. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting later community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current specification already carries the clarified labels and no source edit is needed.
